newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel benefits from Nokia results.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel benefits from Nokia results.

text.p: Shares in Alcatel Alsthom gained another 1.85 percent, or 8.30 francs, to 457.50 francs at 1041 GMT in the wake of results of Finland's Nokia on Thursday. Yesterday, Alcatel closed 8.20 francs up at 449.20.

"Alcatel is up purely on sentiment," said a London-based broker. In Finland, Nokia shares soared on the back of its third quarter profits which showed a strong come-back in mobile phones were sales were up 58 percent. Its third quarter profit was in line with analysts' expectations.
On Wednesday, Alcatel said total nine months sales fell 4.6 percent while telecoms rose to 46.5 billion from 43.8 billion.
